title: verify: DER-only name matching rejects conformant-but-non-identical chains — not documented in public API
description: cert.rs names_equal() uses byte-exact DER comparison with a comment noting it rejects non-conformant CAs that encode the same DN differently. This design choice is not mentioned in the public API docs for verify() or in smime-tree/src/lib.rs. A user who experiences a chain validation failure because their CA has inconsistent DN encoding will have no explanation. Fix: add a note to the verify() doc comment saying 'DN matching is byte-exact DER comparison; chains from CAs that encode DNs inconsistently between issuer and subject fields will be rejected.'
